title: Genre profile (DRAFT)
$comment: DRAFT (owner O65): the contract for FR.7's per-genre values (O36, O37), backlog M9-11; no data file uses it yet. Fields and ranges are Claude's draft for owner review.
description: Per-genre rendering values the checks read from the scene's genre: camera arc ratio with a rotation, apex slow motion, inverted and impact holds, smear and speedline policy, landing dust and impact shake.

camera_arc_ratio.description: Camera arc as a share of a body rotation (O36: anime 0.5, live action 0.1).

apex_slow_motion.description: Playback speed at a rotation's apex.

inverted_hold_frames.description: Graph and LBN only; the prose never prints holds in frames (W1).

float_allowed.description: Anime may declare floats and hangs (O8, O34).
